answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted attestation vines: each agent must lock a small deposit before its claims can propagate, so creating many fake identities multiplies the attacker's locked capital instead of multiplying influence. Honest agents earn nectar-like rewards when their attestations are later confirmed, while a false claim triggers a ripple of slashing that burns the deposits along the whole vine of endorsers. Sybils therefore pay a real, compounding cost for every fake voice, while a single honest identity keeps its full weight.
